text:
Sam (CS): FYI Orchid Labs onboarding is getting a bunch of 429s during initial SDK boot. Pasting their note and a few logs below.
Alex (Orchid): yep, first 10-20 requests after client init fail with 429. Using browser SDK v0.9.3, tokens are short-lived (30s).
Lina (SE): can you paste the client init code and headers? are you doing parallel preflight/handshake? @Ingrid might want to watch quotas.
Alex (Orchid): here's the init we use (simplified):
```js
const token = await fetch('/token').then(r=>r.text());
await Promise.all([client.fetch(...), client.fetch(...), client.fetch(...)]);
// Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
```
Alex (Orchid): we generate token per tab, so on cold start several tabs = many preflight calls.
Sam (CS): that pattern will spike preflight. With ephemeral tokens <60s the gateway can't coalesce preflights by key. Recommend single inflight preflight + short cache on client.
Lina (SE): also check client clock skew — if exp is a few seconds in the past it can cause re-issuance loops. Alex, can you paste decoded JWT exp/iat?
Alex (Orchid): decoded payload: `{ "iat": 1700000000, "exp": 1700000030, "sub": "orchid-frontend" }` — looks like 30s TTL.
Ingrid (SRE): our policy treats ephemeral keys with TTL <45s as high-fanout and applies tighter per-key throttles to protect shared capacity. That explains the 429s. We can either: (1) advise client to use session tokens (~10m) or (2) temporarily raise Orchid's quota while they stabilize.
Sam (CS): quick mitigation we recommend client-side: 1) avoid Promise.all fanout on init, 2) implement singleflight preflight (one inflight token fetch per origin), 3) jittered retry/backoff. Example client limiter: 
```js
let inflight = null;
async function getToken(){
 if(inflight) return inflight;
 inflight = fetch('/token').then(r=>r.text()).finally(()=> inflight = null);
 return inflight;
}
// use getToken() before requests
```
Lina (SE): also add small local cache: store token with expiry and reuse for concurrent requests.
Alex (Orchid): ok will change to singleflight + cache. Might need a quick quota bump while we roll this out. Can you help?
Ingrid (SRE): @Sam I bumped Orchid Labs per-key rate from 120r/m to 600r/m for the next 24h to reduce onboarding noise. DeployBot applied the change.
DeployBot: Quota update: customer=Orchid Labs, key=prod-xyz, old=120/min, new=600/min, expires=+24h.
Alex (Orchid): just deployed the singleflight patch to staging. 429s are down ~90% in the first 10 minutes. Thanks. Still seeing a few on cold start but much better.
Sam (CS): great news. Follow-up: let's schedule a 30min enablement to walk through best practices and confirm session-token rollout. I'll open a calendar invite.
Alex (Orchid): thanks all, appreciate the fast help :rocket:
Lina (SE): I'll prepare a short snippet we can add to the onboarding docs about token TTL recommendations and client concurrency.
Ingrid (SRE): leaving notes in the customer record about temporary bump and to revert if not needed.
Sam (CS): marking this thread as resolved for now — re-open if 429s resurface.
